app.install.title: Install the app
app.install.intro: Keep Secret Santa on your home screen and open it in its own window. An internet connection is required.
app.install.iphone.title: iPhone and iPad
app.install.iphone.steps: Open this site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Add. If shown, leave Open as Web App enabled. Start the app using its new home screen icon.
app.install.android.title: Android
app.install.android.steps: Open this site in Chrome. In the browser menu, choose Install app or Add to Home screen and confirm. Then open the app from its icon.
app.install.desktop.title: Desktop
app.install.desktop.steps: In Chrome or Edge, use the install icon in the address bar or Install this site as an app in the browser menu. In Safari on Mac, use File → Add to Dock. Available commands depend on your browser.
app.install.help: If installation is unavailable, open the site in a supported browser. You can also keep using it in your browser.
share.title: Add a shared link
share.intro: Choose a wishlist and review the product details before saving. You can also paste a copied link here.
share.review_help: Use a title up to 255 characters, a description up to 2000 characters and an HTTP or HTTPS link up to 2048 characters. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
share.no_lists: No wishlist is available yet. Join a group first, then return to add your wish.
share.iphone.title: Sharing on iPhone and iPad
share.iphone.help: Safari on iPhone and iPad cannot offer this PWA as a destination in the system share menu. Copy the product link, open this app, choose “Add a shared link”, paste the link, select a wishlist and confirm.
share.install.title: Receive product links
share.install.support: After installing with a supported Chromium browser on Android or desktop, choose Secret Santa in another app’s share menu. Availability depends on the browser and operating system. If the app is absent, copy the link and use the form below.
share.too_large: The shared content is too long. Paste a shorter product link instead.
